name: Dialogs
shortDescription: Info dialog with a button, and dialog with up to 5 choices (like a pause menu). Mouse, touch, keyboard and gamepad support.
description: Dialogs to show to the player:
- an **info dialog**: a message with a button (like "OK"), to close it,
- a **choices dialog**: up to 5 choices to pick from, like a pause menu or a question.
Both can have a title, an icon and a close button. They work with the mouse, touchscreens, keyboards (arrows, Enter, Escape) and gamepads.
Ready-to-use dialogs in many styles are in the asset store [info and choices dialogs pack](https://editor.gdevelop.io/?initial-dialog=asset-store&asset-pack=info-and-choices-dialogs).
